# Cold Pressed vs Fresh Juice: What's the Difference?
URL: https://fruitzen.in/resources/cold-pressed-vs-fresh-juice
Updated: 2026-11-02

Cold pressed juice is made by slowly pressing fruit, while fresh juice is usually made in a fast-spinning juicer or blender. Both start with whole fruit. Cold pressed juice tends to be smoother with brighter colour and costs a little more. FruitZen, a juice bar in Kukatpally, Hyderabad, serves both side by side: fresh juices from ₹50 and cold pressed juices from ₹60, all made to order.

## How Is Cold Pressed Juice Made?

A cold press machine crushes fruit and then presses it under pressure to release the juice. There is no high-speed blade spinning through the fruit. The process is slower, and it usually takes more fruit to fill a glass.

At FruitZen in Kukatpally, cold pressed juices are pressed when you order. FruitZen's list is short: Mosambi, Pineapple, Orange (Imported Malta) and Pomegranate. All four have no added sugar.

## How Is Regular Fresh Juice Made?

Most juice shops in Hyderabad make fresh juice with a centrifugal juicer or a mixer-blender. A fast blade breaks the fruit and spins out the juice in seconds. It is quick and affordable, which is why it is the standard at local juice centres.

FruitZen's fresh juices are also made to order from fruit sourced every morning. The range is wider: 19 fresh juices from Banana (₹50) to Pomegranate and Avocado (₹120).

## Cold Pressed vs Fresh Juice: Side-by-Side

| Factor | Cold pressed juice | Fresh juice |
|---|---|---|
| How it's made | Slow pressing | Fast-spinning juicer or blender |
| Texture | Smooth, less froth | Lighter, can be frothy |
| Colour and flavour | Usually brighter, more intense | Fresh, can be milder |
| Fruit per glass | More | Less |
| Price at FruitZen | ₹60–₹150 | ₹50–₹120 |
| Choice at FruitZen | 4 juices | 19 juices |

## When Should You Pick Cold Pressed Juice?

Choose cold pressed when you want a smooth, intense juice with nothing added. Pomegranate (₹150) and Orange from Imported Malta (₹149) show the difference most clearly. Cold pressed Mosambi is ₹60, the same as FruitZen's fresh Mosambi, so it is an easy first try.

## When Should You Pick Fresh Juice?

Choose fresh juice for variety and everyday value. Watermelon (₹50) is hydrating on a hot Hyderabad afternoon. ABC (Apple, Beetroot & Carrot, ₹80) is the most-asked-for blend. Fresh juice is also what goes into FruitZen's combos, such as the Student Combo (₹129).

## How FruitZen Helps You Choose

FruitZen keeps both juice styles on one counter in Kukatpally, so you can taste the difference yourself. Staff will suggest a cold pressed or fresh option based on what you like. Learn more on the [cold pressed juice in Kukatpally](/resources/cold-pressed-juice-kukatpally) page, or find timings and delivery details in the [FruitZen FAQ](/resources/fruitzen-juice-bar-kukatpally-faq).

## Key Takeaways

- Cold pressed juice is pressed slowly; fresh juice is spun or blended fast
- Cold pressed is smoother and more intense and uses more fruit per glass
- FruitZen serves 4 cold pressed juices (₹60–₹150) and 19 fresh juices (₹50–₹120)
- FruitZen's cold pressed juices have no added sugar
- Try both at FruitZen near the HP Petrol Pump, Kukatpally, 9 am–11 pm daily

## FAQs

**Q: What is the difference between cold pressed and fresh juice?**
A: Cold pressed juice is made by pressing fruit to squeeze out the juice, while regular fresh juice is usually made in a high-speed juicer or blender. FruitZen in Kukatpally serves both: fresh juices from ₹50 and cold pressed juices from ₹60.

**Q: Is cold pressed juice healthier than fresh juice?**
A: Both are made from whole fruit. Cold pressing is slower and avoids a fast spinning blade, so many people find the juice smoother with brighter colour and flavour. FruitZen's cold pressed juices are 100% natural with no added sugar.

**Q: Why is cold pressed juice more expensive?**
A: Cold pressing takes longer and uses more fruit per glass. At FruitZen, cold pressed Pomegranate costs ₹150 and fresh Pomegranate juice costs ₹120.

**Q: Which juice should I choose for daily drinking?**
A: For everyday drinking, an affordable fresh juice such as Mosambi or Watermelon works well. FruitZen's cold pressed Mosambi is ₹60, the same price as its fresh Mosambi juice.

**Q: Where can I try cold pressed juice in Hyderabad?**
A: FruitZen near the HP Petrol Pump in Kukatpally, Hyderabad presses juice to order daily from 9 am to 11 pm. It also delivers on Swiggy and Zomato.

## How FruitZen Makes Cold Pressed Juice {#how-fruitzen-makes-cold-pressed-juice}

FruitZen buys fruit every morning and picks it for ripeness, so nothing sits overnight. Cold pressed juices are extracted with a cold-press machine rather than a high-speed blender. Pressing keeps the colour and natural flavour that a fast blade can flatten.

Every cold pressed juice is made when you order it. FruitZen does not pre-mix or batch juices in advance. If you are comparing methods, read [cold pressed vs fresh juice](/resources/cold-pressed-vs-fresh-juice) for a plain-English breakdown.

## What Makes FruitZen Cold Pressed Juice Different? {#what-makes-fruitzen-cold-pressed-juice-different}

Most juice centres in Kukatpally serve blended fresh juice only. FruitZen offers cold pressed juice and fresh juice side by side at neighbourhood prices. Mall juice bars in Hyderabad typically charge ₹200–₹400; FruitZen's cold pressed range stays at ₹60–₹150.

FruitZen holds a 5.0★ rating on Google. One reviewer wrote: "The fruit quality is amazing, and you can actually taste the freshness." That freshness comes from the daily sourcing and made-to-order rule above.

- **No added sugar** in any cold pressed juice
- **Pressed to order**, never pre-bottled for the day
- **Open late**: until 11 pm, every day
- **Gym-friendly menu** nearby, with protein and recovery shakes ([see gym options](/resources/protein-shakes-near-jntu-kukatpally))

## When Should You Drink Cold Pressed Juice?

Cold pressed juice works well as part of breakfast, as a mid-afternoon refresher, or after a walk or workout. Pair a Mosambi (₹60) with a fruit bowl (from ₹70) for a light morning meal. For something more filling after the gym, FruitZen's Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie (₹190) is the regulars' pick.

Juice tastes best within minutes of pressing. If you are ordering for delivery, drink it soon after it arrives.
